newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SUZUKI SAYS TO BUILD FACE-LIFTED SWIFT IN HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: SUZUKI SAYS TO BUILD FACE-LIFTED SWIFT IN HUNGARY.

text.p: Suzuki Motor Corp said on Thursday its Hungarian plant will start building a face-lifted version of its Swift car.
Production will start in mid-October and the model will be available in 13 versions, the company said in a statement.
"The new face-lifted Swift will have a strong competitiveness to cope with the severe market situation in Hungary, " Shinzo Nakanishi, sales director for the Hungarian plant Magyar Suzuki Rt, said.
Nakanishi spoke at a news conference to introduce the car, which he also said will be premiering on Thursday at the Paris Auto Show.
"Hungary's car market will remain depressed in 1996, reaching only last year's sales level of 70,000 units sold," he said.
Magyar Suzuki plans to produce 50,000 Hungarian-built cars in 1996 -- 36,500 for export and 13,500 for domestic sales, Nakanishi said.
Between January and September this year Magyar Suzuki had sold 26,289 vehicles abroad and 9,354 domestically, the statement said.
